result.judge_notes: pass 1 (A=with, B=without): Both answers give concrete CSS stacks that pair a serif heading with a system-ui body, and both give fallbacks. B explains its choice better, especially the point that Georgia's numbers rise and drop below the line, which suits headlines but not invoices. A is clearer about the limits: it says outright that the headings will look different on each platform, tells you to check Mac, Windows and Android, and says to confirm web licensing when upgrading. B mostly skips that, and its extra alternatives make it a little padded. | pass 2 (A=without, B=with): Both answers recommend a system serif for headings and system-ui for body, and both give sensible fallback stacks and use tabular-nums for money. B wins mainly on honesty about limits: it says plainly that the heading will look different on each platform, tells the founder to test on Mac, Windows and Android, and explains what needs licensing review before an upgrade. A gives a richer tone rationale and a useful warning about Georgia's old-style numerals, but it is weaker on cross-platform caveats and leans partly on 'modern and uncluttered'.
